label.zh: 两个满觉察度入口（另有隐藏的入侵/轰炸入口 awareness.125）
label.en: Two full-awareness entries (plus the hidden invade/bombard entry awareness.125)

note.zh: 910：觉察度升到“完全”时（on_awareness_level_increase → 900）建立通信；920：由前超光速科技进步局势（preftl.41）在已达完全觉察后触发的“监视者”事件。125：对前超光速行星轰炸或入侵时把觉察度设为100并立即建立联系。
note.en: 910: when awareness rises to full (on_awareness_level_increase -> 900) comms are established; 920: fired by the pre-FTL tech-progress situation (preftl.41) once full awareness was reached. 125: bombarding or invading a pre-FTL planet sets awareness to 100 and contacts them at once.

notes.zh: 窗口文字取决于被接触文明的觉察度等级（无/低/中/高/完全）与其是否被入侵。
notes.en: The window text depends on the contacted civilization's awareness level (none/low/medium/high/full) and whether it is being invaded.

notes.zh: action.2 的 after 块按条件在 progress.4/5/6 中择一；这三个窗口属于故事 event-action-1（首次接触），此处只作外链，不复制。
notes.en: The after block of action.2 picks one of progress.4/5/6 by condition; those windows belong to the story event-action-1 (First Contact) and are only linked externally here, not copied.

scope.zh: 前超光速文明因完全觉察而首次接触：入侵/轰炸、满觉察度或“监视者”三个入口汇入同一“首次接触”窗口。
scope.en: Pre-FTL first contact through awareness: invasion/bombardment, full awareness or "Who Watches the Watchers" all converge on one First Contact window.

uncertain: action.2 and progress.4/5/6 are also used by ordinary first contact (first_contact.6000), so these windows are shared across stories; here they are only this story's convergence point.
